versions.text: Criterion: Verify that all the moments and products of inertia have been defined and assessed for safety of flight. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within MIL-STD-1797, 4.1.3.3 Determining moments and products of inertia. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include inspection of requirements, design, and configuration documentation.
